title: catalog.strip
description: The scrub strip of a video: small frames at known times, for the player to show while the pointer drags along the timeline, seeking exactly only on release. Answered at once with the best strip on disk (the even pass over the keyframes pass; ready false when there is none yet) and building true while a pass is being made in the background; catalog.strip_ready says when each pass is written, and asking again then gives it. The keyframes pass decodes only keyframes, so it is quick even at 4K; when they are sparser than one every 2 seconds an even pass follows, at an even interval, at most 600 frames, and it waits while a job runs or a command-line run holds the library. A file the catalog lists as a present censored output gets a clear strip; any other file's frames are shrunk and blurred like a source thumbnail before anything is written (blurred true). image is the strip's JPEG in the cache folder: the frames in rows of columns, each tile in size; frames are their times in seconds. Refused with catalog.no_such_file when the path is not a file.

path.description: An absolute path to a video file.
